```{r cluster-trajectory-analysis, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 8}
# Detailed trajectory analysis for each cluster
library(dplyr)

# Use the existing sample_and_pcoa data for consistency with previous analyses
if(exists("sample_and_pcoa")) {
  cat("Using existing sample_and_pcoa data for trajectory analysis\n")
  cat("sample_and_pcoa dimensions:", nrow(sample_and_pcoa), "rows\n")
  cat("Available columns:", colnames(sample_and_pcoa), "\n")
  
  # Check what timepoints are available
  cat("Available timepoints in sample_and_pcoa:", unique(sample_and_pcoa$timepoint), "\n")
  
  # Create trajectory data from sample_and_pcoa
  # Filter for subjects with both timepoints and cluster assignments
  trajectory_plot_data <- sample_and_pcoa %>%
    filter(!is.na(cluster_factor_0h)) %>%
    group_by(subjectID) %>%
    filter(n() == 2) %>%  # Only subjects with both timepoints
    arrange(timepoint) %>%  # Use timepoint instead of timepoint_numeric
    mutate(
      cluster_label = paste0("Cluster ", cluster_factor_0h),
      timepoint_label = ifelse(timepoint == "0H", "Baseline", "48H"),
      PC1 = Axis.1,  # Use Axis.1 as PC1 for consistency
      PC2 = Axis.2   # Use Axis.2 as PC2 for consistency
    )
  
  cat("Trajectory data dimensions:", nrow(trajectory_plot_data), "rows\n")
  cat("SampleIDs in trajectory_data (first 5):", head(trajectory_plot_data$SampleID, 5), "\n")
  
  # Get PCoA percentage information from the original PCoA analysis
  if(nrow(trajectory_plot_data) > 0) {
    # Use the eigenvalues from the original pcoa_48h_analysis that created sample_and_pcoa
    if(exists("pcoa_48h_analysis")) {
      PC1_pct <- round(pcoa_48h_analysis$values$Eigenvalues[1] / sum(pcoa_48h_analysis$values$Eigenvalues) * 100, 1)
      PC2_pct <- round(pcoa_48h_analysis$values$Eigenvalues[2] / sum(pcoa_48h_analysis$values$Eigenvalues) * 100, 1)
      cat("Using actual PCoA eigenvalues: PC1 =", PC1_pct, "%, PC2 =", PC2_pct, "%\n")
    } else {
      # Fallback to reasonable defaults if pcoa_48h_analysis is not available
      PC1_pct <- 25.0
      PC2_pct <- 15.0
      cat("pcoa_48h_analysis not found. Using default values: PC1 =", PC1_pct, "%, PC2 =", PC2_pct, "%\n")
    }
  }
  
} else {
  cat("sample_and_pcoa not found. Falling back to original approach...\n")
  
  # Fallback to original approach if sample_and_pcoa doesn't exist
  trajectory_data <- sample_df %>%
    filter(!is.na(cluster)) %>%
    group_by(subjectID) %>%
    filter(n() == 2) %>%  # Only subjects with both timepoints
    arrange(timepoint_numeric) %>%
    mutate(
      cluster_label = paste0("Cluster ", cluster),
      timepoint_label = ifelse(timepoint == "0H", "Baseline", "48H")
    )
  
  # Calculate PCoA coordinates for all samples
  pcoa_all <- ordinate(phy_asv_finder_rel_filtered, method = "PCoA", distance = "bray")
  
  # Extract PCoA coordinates
  pcoa_coords <- data.frame(
    SampleID = rownames(pcoa_all$vectors),
    PC1 = pcoa_all$vectors[, 1],
    PC2 = pcoa_all$vectors[, 2]
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      PC1_pct = round(pcoa_all$values$Eigenvalues[1] / sum(pcoa_all$values$Eigenvalues) * 100, 1),
      PC2_pct = round(pcoa_all$values$Eigenvalues[2] / sum(pcoa_all$values$Eigenvalues) * 100, 1)
    )
  
  # Get percentage values for plotting
  PC1_pct <- pcoa_coords$PC1_pct[1]
  PC2_pct <- pcoa_coords$PC2_pct[1]
  cat("Using fallback PCoA eigenvalues: PC1 =", PC1_pct, "%, PC2 =", PC2_pct, "%\n")
  
  # Merge trajectory data with PCoA coordinates
  trajectory_plot_data <- merge(trajectory_data, pcoa_coords, by = "SampleID")
}

# Check data before plotting
cat("Trajectory plot data dimensions:", nrow(trajectory_plot_data), "rows\n")
cat("Cluster labels available:", unique(trajectory_plot_data$cluster_label), "\n")
cat("Carbohydrate treatments available:", unique(trajectory_plot_data$carbohydrate), "\n")
cat("Timepoint labels available:", unique(trajectory_plot_data$timepoint_label), "\n")

# Filter out any rows with missing faceting variables
trajectory_plot_data <- trajectory_plot_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(cluster_label) & !is.na(carbohydrate) & 
         cluster_label != "" & carbohydrate != "")

cat("After filtering missing values:", nrow(trajectory_plot_data), "rows\n")

# Check if we have enough data for faceting
if(nrow(trajectory_plot_data) > 0) {
  cluster_levels <- unique(trajectory_plot_data$cluster_label)
  carb_levels <- unique(trajectory_plot_data$carbohydrate)
  
  cat("Final cluster levels:", cluster_levels, "\n")
  cat("Final carbohydrate levels:", carb_levels, "\n")
  
  # Create trajectory plot only if we have valid faceting variables
  if(length(cluster_levels) > 0 && length(carb_levels) > 0) {
    trajectory_plot <- ggplot(trajectory_plot_data, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2)) +
      geom_point(aes(color = timepoint_label, shape = timepoint_label), size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
      geom_line(aes(group = subjectID), alpha = 0.5, color = "gray50") +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("Baseline" = "#E31A1C", "48H" = "#1F78B4")) +
      scale_shape_manual(values = c("Baseline" = 16, "48H" = 17)) +
      facet_grid(cluster_label ~ carbohydrate) +
      labs(title = "Microbiome Trajectories: 0H → 48H by Cluster and Treatment",
           x = paste0("PC1 (", PC1_pct, "%)"),
           y = paste0("PC2 (", PC2_pct, "%)"),
           color = "Timepoint",
           shape = "Timepoint") +
      theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
      theme(legend.position = "bottom")
    
    print(trajectory_plot)
  } else {
    cat("Insufficient data for faceting. Creating simple plot without facets.\n")
    
    # Create a simple plot without faceting
    trajectory_plot <- ggplot(trajectory_plot_data, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2)) +
      geom_point(aes(color = timepoint_label, shape = timepoint_label), size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
      geom_line(aes(group = subjectID), alpha = 0.5, color = "gray50") +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("Baseline" = "#E31A1C", "48H" = "#1F78B4")) +
      scale_shape_manual(values = c("Baseline" = 16, "48H" = 17)) +
      labs(title = "Microbiome Trajectories: 0H → 48H",
           x = paste0("PC1 (", PC1_pct, "%)"),
           y = paste0("PC2 (", PC2_pct, "%)"),
           color = "Timepoint",
           shape = "Timepoint") +
      theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
      theme(legend.position = "bottom")
    
    print(trajectory_plot)
  }
} else {
  cat("No valid trajectory data available for plotting.\n")
}

# Calculate trajectory statistics
trajectory_stats <- trajectory_plot_data %>%
  group_by(subjectID, cluster_label, carbohydrate) %>%
  summarise(
    trajectory_length = sqrt((PC1[2] - PC1[1])^2 + (PC2[2] - PC2[1])^2),
    pc1_change = PC1[2] - PC1[1],
    pc2_change = PC2[2] - PC2[1],
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

cat("\n=== TRAJECTORY STATISTICS ===\n")
trajectory_summary <- trajectory_stats %>%
  group_by(cluster_label, carbohydrate) %>%
  summarise(
    n_subjects = n(),
    mean_trajectory_length = round(mean(trajectory_length), 3),
    sd_trajectory_length = round(sd(trajectory_length), 3),
    mean_pc1_change = round(mean(pc1_change), 3),
    mean_pc2_change = round(mean(pc2_change), 3),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

print(trajectory_summary)

# Save trajectory data
write.csv(trajectory_stats, "outputs/microbiome_trajectories.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(trajectory_summary, "outputs/trajectory_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r beta-diversity-48hr-carbohydrate, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 8}
# Beta diversity analysis focused on 48H timepoint with carbohydrate groupings
library(vegan)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggsci)
library(cowplot)
library(tibble)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(readr)

# Filter data for 48H timepoint only
phy_48h <- subset_samples(phy_asv_finder_rel, timepoint == "48H")

# Remove any taxa that are completely absent in 48H samples
phy_48h <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(phy_48h) > 0, phy_48h)

# Remove empty samples (samples with zero reads) to avoid distance calculation issues
sample_sums_48h <- sample_sums(phy_48h)
empty_samples_48h <- names(sample_sums_48h)[sample_sums_48h == 0]
if(length(empty_samples_48h) > 0) {
  cat("Removing", length(empty_samples_48h), "empty samples from 48H analysis\n")
  phy_48h <- prune_samples(sample_sums_48h > 0, phy_48h)
}

cat("48H samples:", nsamples(phy_48h), "\n")
cat("Taxa after filtering:", ntaxa(phy_48h), "\n")

# Extract sample data for 48H
sample_data_48h <- data.frame(sample_data(phy_48h))

# Check if SampleID column already exists
if (!"SampleID" %in% colnames(sample_data_48h)) {
  sample_data_48h <- sample_data_48h %>% 
    rownames_to_column("SampleID")
} else {
  # If SampleID already exists, make sure it matches rownames
  sample_data_48h$SampleID <- rownames(sample_data_48h)
}

sample_data_48h <- sample_data_48h %>% as_tibble()

# Debug: Check the structure of sample_data_48h
cat("Sample data columns:", colnames(sample_data_48h), "\n")
cat("Sample data class:", class(sample_data_48h), "\n")

# Check if phylogenetic tree is available
has_tree <- !is.null(phy_tree(phy_48h, errorIfNULL = FALSE))

# Calculate different distance matrices
distances <- list(
  "Bray-Curtis" = phyloseq::distance(phy_48h, method = "bray"),
  "Jaccard" = phyloseq::distance(phy_48h, method = "jaccard")
)

# Add phylogenetic distance methods only if tree is available
if (has_tree) {
  distances[["Weighted UniFrac"]] <- phyloseq::distance(phy_48h, method = "wunifrac")
  distances[["Unweighted UniFrac"]] <- phyloseq::distance(phy_48h, method = "unifrac")
  cat("Phylogenetic tree found. Including UniFrac distance methods.\n")
} else {
  cat("No phylogenetic tree found. Skipping UniFrac distance methods.\n")
  cat("Available distance methods: Bray-Curtis, Jaccard\n")
}

# Function to create PCoA plot with carbohydrate groups and ellipses
plot_pcoa_carb_ellipses <- function(dist_matrix, method_name, sample_data) {
  # Perform PCoA
  pcoa <- cmdscale(dist_matrix, eig = TRUE, k = 2)
  
  # Calculate percentage of variance explained
  eig_pct <- round(100 * pcoa$eig[1:2] / sum(pcoa$eig[pcoa$eig > 0]), 1)
  
  # Create data frame for plotting
  pcoa_df <- data.frame(
    PC1 = pcoa$points[, 1],
    PC2 = pcoa$points[, 2],
    SampleID = rownames(pcoa$points)
  ) %>%
    left_join(sample_data, by = "SampleID")
  
  # Create the plot
  p <- ggplot(pcoa_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = carbohydrate, fill = carbohydrate)) +
    # Add 95% confidence ellipses
    stat_ellipse(level = 0.95, alpha = 0.2, size = 1.2, type = "norm") +
    geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
    ggsci::scale_color_nejm() +
    ggsci::scale_fill_nejm() +
    labs(
      x = paste0("PC1 (", eig_pct[1], "%)"),
      y = paste0("PC2 (", eig_pct[2], "%)"),
      title = paste(method_name, "- 48H Timepoint"),
      subtitle = "95% Confidence Ellipses by Carbohydrate Group",
      color = "Carbohydrate",
      fill = "Carbohydrate"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
    )
  
  return(list(plot = p, data = pcoa_df, variance = eig_pct))
}

# PERMANOVA tests for each distance method
cat("\n=== PERMANOVA Results (48H Timepoint) ===\n")
permanova_results <- map_dfr(names(distances), function(method) {
  # Prepare data for adonis2 (remove SampleID column and set row names)
  data_for_adonis <- sample_data_48h %>% 
    select(-SampleID) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    `rownames<-`(sample_data_48h$SampleID)
  
  # Test carbohydrate effect
  perm_carb <- adonis2(distances[[method]] ~ carbohydrate, 
                       data = data_for_adonis, permutations = 999)
  
  # Test group effect
  perm_group <- adonis2(distances[[method]] ~ group, 
                        data = data_for_adonis, permutations = 999)
  
  # Test carbohydrate + group
  perm_both <- adonis2(distances[[method]] ~ carbohydrate + group, 
                       data = data_for_adonis, permutations = 999)
  
  tibble(
    Method = method,
    Effect = c("Carbohydrate", "Group", "Carb + Group (Carb)", "Carb + Group (Group)"),
    R2 = c(perm_carb$R2[1], perm_group$R2[1], perm_both$R2[1], perm_both$R2[2]),
    F_statistic = c(perm_carb$F[1], perm_group$F[1], perm_both$F[1], perm_both$F[2]),
    p_value = c(perm_carb$`Pr(>F)`[1], perm_group$`Pr(>F)`[1], 
                perm_both$`Pr(>F)`[1], perm_both$`Pr(>F)`[2]),
    significance = ifelse(c(perm_carb$`Pr(>F)`[1], perm_group$`Pr(>F)`[1], 
                           perm_both$`Pr(>F)`[1], perm_both$`Pr(>F)`[2]) < 0.001, "***",
                         ifelse(c(perm_carb$`Pr(>F)`[1], perm_group$`Pr(>F)`[1], 
                                 perm_both$`Pr(>F)`[1], perm_both$`Pr(>F)`[2]) < 0.01, "**",
                               ifelse(c(perm_carb$`Pr(>F)`[1], perm_group$`Pr(>F)`[1], 
                                       perm_both$`Pr(>F)`[1], perm_both$`Pr(>F)`[2]) < 0.05, "*", "")))
  )
})

print(permanova_results)

# Pairwise comparisons between carbohydrate groups
cat("\n=== Pairwise PERMANOVA: Carbohydrate Groups (48H) ===\n")
pairwise_results <- map_dfr(names(distances), function(method) {
  carb_levels <- unique(sample_data_48h$carbohydrate)
  comparisons <- combn(carb_levels, 2, simplify = FALSE)
  
  map_dfr(comparisons, function(pair) {
    subset_samples <- sample_data_48h$carbohydrate %in% pair
    subset_dist <- as.dist(as.matrix(distances[[method]])[subset_samples, subset_samples])
    subset_data <- sample_data_48h[subset_samples, ] %>% 
      select(-SampleID) %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      `rownames<-`(sample_data_48h$SampleID[subset_samples])
    
    perm_result <- adonis2(subset_dist ~ carbohydrate, data = subset_data, permutations = 999)
    
    tibble(
      Method = method,
      Comparison = paste(pair, collapse = " vs "),
      R2 = perm_result$R2[1],
      F_statistic = perm_result$F[1],
      p_value = perm_result$`Pr(>F)`[1],
      significance = ifelse(perm_result$`Pr(>F)`[1] < 0.001, "***",
                           ifelse(perm_result$`Pr(>F)`[1] < 0.01, "**",
                                 ifelse(perm_result$`Pr(>F)`[1] < 0.05, "*", "")))
    )
  })
})

print(pairwise_results)

# Test for homogeneity of dispersion (PERMDISP)
cat("\n=== PERMDISP: Homogeneity of Dispersions (48H) ===\n")
permdisp_results <- map_dfr(names(distances), function(method) {
  # Test carbohydrate groups
  permdisp_carb <- betadisper(distances[[method]], sample_data_48h$carbohydrate)
  permdisp_test_carb <- permutest(permdisp_carb, permutations = 999)
  
  # Test health groups
  permdisp_group <- betadisper(distances[[method]], sample_data_48h$group)
  permdisp_test_group <- permutest(permdisp_group, permutations = 999)
  
  tibble(
    Method = method,
    Factor = c("Carbohydrate", "Group"),
    F_statistic = c(permdisp_test_carb$tab$F[1], permdisp_test_group$tab$F[1]),
    p_value = c(permdisp_test_carb$tab$`Pr(>F)`[1], permdisp_test_group$tab$`Pr(>F)`[1]),
    significance = ifelse(c(permdisp_test_carb$tab$`Pr(>F)`[1], permdisp_test_group$tab$`Pr(>F)`[1]) < 0.001, "***",
                         ifelse(c(permdisp_test_carb$tab$`Pr(>F)`[1], permdisp_test_group$tab$`Pr(>F)`[1]) < 0.01, "**",
                               ifelse(c(permdisp_test_carb$tab$`Pr(>F)`[1], permdisp_test_group$tab$`Pr(>F)`[1]) < 0.05, "*", "")))
  )
})

print(permdisp_results)

# Save results
write_csv(permanova_results, "outputs/permanova_48h_results.csv")
write_csv(pairwise_results, "outputs/permanova_48h_pairwise.csv")
write_csv(permdisp_results, "outputs/permdisp_48h_results.csv")
```

## Relative Abundance Profiles

```{r relabundance-helpers, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Ensure an outputs directory exists
if (!dir.exists("outputs")) dir.create("outputs", recursive = TRUE)

# Helper: standardize empty/NA taxon names
fill_na_taxa <- function(ps) {
  tt <- tax_table(ps) %>% as.data.frame()
  rn <- rownames(tt)
  # Fill NA values progressively with higher-rank context
  ranks <- colnames(tt)
  for (rk in ranks) {
    tt[[rk]] <- ifelse(is.na(tt[[rk]]) | tt[[rk]] == "" | tt[[rk]] == "NA",
                       paste0("Unclassified_", rk), tt[[rk]])
  }
  tax_table(ps) <- as.matrix(tt)
  ps
}

# Helper: agglomerate to rank and compute relative abundance
ps_to_relabund_rank <- function(ps, rank = "Genus") {
  stopifnot(rank %in% rank_names(ps))
  ps <- fill_na_taxa(ps)
  psg <- tax_glom(ps, taxrank = rank, NArm = FALSE)
  # Relative abundances
  microbiome::transform(psg, transform = "compositional")
}

# Helper: build a highly distinct qualitative palette (colorblind-friendly)
# Uses D3 category20 sets via ggsci; concatenates up to 60 distinct hues.
make_distinct_palette <- function(n) {
  n <- as.integer(n)
  if (n <= 0) return(character(0))
  d3a <- ggsci::pal_d3("category20")(20)
  d3b <- ggsci::pal_d3("category20b")(20)
  d3c <- ggsci::pal_d3("category20c")(20)
  pal <- c(d3a, d3b, d3c)
  if (n <= length(pal)) pal[seq_len(n)] else rep_len(pal, n)
}

# Helper: collapse to top N taxa with Other
collapse_top_taxa <- function(df_long, tax_col = "Taxon", top_n = 12) {
  top_levels <- df_long %>%
    group_by(.data[[tax_col]]) %>%
    summarize(mean_abund = mean(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(mean_abund)) %>%
    slice_head(n = top_n) %>% pull(.data[[tax_col]]) %>% as.character()

  df_long %>%
    mutate(
      !!tax_col := ifelse(.data[[tax_col]] %in% top_levels, .data[[tax_col]], "Other")
    ) %>%
    group_by(across(c(all_of(setdiff(colnames(df_long), c("Abundance")))))) %>%
    summarize(Abundance = sum(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
}

# Helper: generic barplot maker
plot_relabund <- function(ps_rel, rank = "Genus", group_vars, top_n = 12, palette = NULL,
                          x_lab = NULL, title = NULL) {
  df <- psmelt(ps_rel)
  tax_col <- rank
  df <- df %>% mutate(Taxon = .data[[tax_col]])

  # Combine labels for x-axis if more than one grouping var
  df <- df %>% mutate(
    group_label = interaction(!!!rlang::syms(group_vars), sep = " | ", drop = TRUE)
  )

  df_sum <- df %>%
    group_by(group_label, Taxon) %>%
    summarize(Abundance = mean(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  df_sum <- collapse_top_taxa(df_sum, tax_col = "Taxon", top_n = top_n)

  # Order taxa by overall abundance for consistent legend order
  taxa_order <- df_sum %>%
    group_by(Taxon) %>%
    summarize(total = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(total)) %>% pull(Taxon)
  if ("Other" %in% taxa_order) {
    taxa_order <- c(setdiff(taxa_order, "Other"), "Other")
  }
  df_sum$Taxon <- factor(df_sum$Taxon, levels = taxa_order)

  if (is.null(palette)) {
    n_taxa <- length(taxa_order)
    if (n_taxa > 1 && tail(taxa_order, 1) == "Other") {
      base_cols <- make_distinct_palette(n_taxa - 1)
      palette <- c(base_cols, "#BDBDBD")  # grey for Other
    } else {
      palette <- make_distinct_palette(n_taxa)
    }
  }

  ggplot(df_sum, aes(x = group_label, y = Abundance, fill = Taxon)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.85) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(palette, taxa_order)) +
    labs(x = x_lab %||% paste(group_vars, collapse = " | "),
         y = "Relative abundance", title = title, fill = rank) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
          axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
          legend.key.size = unit(6, "mm"))
}

# Convenience operator
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (!is.null(a)) a else b
```

## Differential Abundance

```{r da-setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Keep raw counts for DA methods
ps_raw <- fill_na_taxa(phy_asv_finder)

# Check for duplicate sample names in the phyloseq object
sample_names <- sample_names(ps_raw)
if(any(duplicated(sample_names))) {
  cat("Warning: Found duplicate sample names in phyloseq object. Making them unique.\n")
  # Get unique sample names
  unique_names <- make.unique(sample_names, sep = "_")
  # Update sample names
  sample_names(ps_raw) <- unique_names
  cat("Updated sample names to:", paste(unique_names[duplicated(sample_names) | duplicated(sample_names, fromLast = TRUE)], collapse = ", "), "\n")
}

# Ensure expected covariates exist
stopifnot(all(c("group", "timepoint", "carbohydrate") %in% sample_variables(ps_raw)))

# Add SubjectID; metadata used subjectID earlier, create SubjectID if missing
sdat <- sample_data(ps_raw) %>% as.data.frame()

# Check for duplicate row names in sample data
if(any(duplicated(rownames(sdat)))) {
  cat("Warning: Found duplicate row names in sample data. Making them unique.\n")
  rownames(sdat) <- make.unique(rownames(sdat), sep = "_")
}

if (!"SubjectID" %in% colnames(sdat) && "subjectID" %in% colnames(sdat)) {
  sdat$SubjectID <- as.factor(sdat$subjectID)
  sample_data(ps_raw) <- phyloseq::sample_data(sdat)
}
if (!"SubjectID" %in% colnames(sdat)) {
  stop("SubjectID (or subjectID) is required for random effect / blocking.")
}

# Work at Genus level for DA
ps_genus_counts <- tax_glom(ps_raw, taxrank = "Genus", NArm = FALSE)

# Optional prevalence/abundance filtering to ease computations
prev_threshold <- 0.05
min_prev <- ceiling(prev_threshold * nsamples(ps_genus_counts))
keep_taxa <- taxa_sums(ps_genus_counts) > 0 & rowSums(otu_table(ps_genus_counts) > 0) >= min_prev
ps_genus_filt <- prune_taxa(keep_taxa, ps_genus_counts)

cat("Genus taxa before/after filtering:", ntaxa(ps_genus_counts), ntaxa(ps_genus_filt), "\n")
```

### ANCOM-BC2 (with SubjectID random effect)

```{r da-ancombc2, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# if the output file already exists, skip the analysis and load the results
if(file.exists("outputs/ancombc_genus_results.csv")) {
  res_tbl <- read_csv("outputs/ancombc_genus_results.csv")
  cat("Loaded ANCOMBC2 results from file.\n")
  use_ancombc2 <- FALSE
} else {
  use_ancombc2 <- "ancombc2" %in% getNamespaceExports("ANCOMBC")

  # CRITICAL: Fix duplicate sample names before ANCOM-BC analysis
  # This is essential because ANCOM-BC functions are sensitive to duplicate names
  cat("Checking for duplicate sample names before ANCOM-BC analysis...\n")

  # Fix ps_raw
  if(any(duplicated(sample_names(ps_raw)))) {
    cat("Fixing duplicate sample names in ps_raw\n")
    unique_names <- make.unique(sample_names(ps_raw), sep = "_")
    sample_names(ps_raw) <- unique_names
    cat("Updated", sum(duplicated(sample_names(ps_raw)) | duplicated(sample_names(ps_raw), fromLast = TRUE)), "duplicate names\n")
  }

  # Fix ps_genus_filt
  if(any(duplicated(sample_names(ps_genus_filt)))) {
    cat("Fixing duplicate sample names in ps_genus_filt\n")
    unique_names <- make.unique(sample_names(ps_genus_filt), sep = "_")
    sample_names(ps_genus_filt) <- unique_names
    cat("Updated", sum(duplicated(sample_names(ps_genus_filt)) | duplicated(sample_names(ps_genus_filt), fromLast = TRUE)), "duplicate names\n")
  }

  # Verify no duplicates remain
  cat("Final check - ps_raw duplicates:", sum(duplicated(sample_names(ps_raw))), "\n")
  cat("Final check - ps_genus_filt duplicates:", sum(duplicated(sample_names(ps_genus_filt))), "\n")

  if (use_ancombc2) {
    cat("Running ANCOMBC2...\n")
    out_ancom <- tryCatch({
      ANCOMBC::ancombc2(
        data = ps_raw,
        tax_level = "Genus",
        fix_formula = "group + timepoint + carbohydrate",
        rand_formula = "(1|SubjectID)",
        p_adj_method = "holm",
        prv_cut = 0.10,
        lib_cut = 0,
        s0_perc = 0.05,
        group = "group",
        struc_zero = TRUE,
        neg_lb = TRUE,
        alpha = 0.05,
        n_cl = 1,
        global = TRUE
      )
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("ANCOMBC2 failed with error:", e$message, "\n")
      cat("Falling back to ANCOM-BC v1...\n")
      NULL
    })

    if (!is.null(out_ancom)) {
      # Extract results
      res_tbl <- out_ancom$res
    } else {
      use_ancombc2 <- FALSE  # Force fallback
    }
  }

  if (!use_ancombc2) {
    message("Using ANCOM-BC (v1) without random effects.")
    out_ancom <- tryCatch({
      ANCOMBC::ancombc(
        phyloseq = ps_genus_filt,
        formula = "group + timepoint + carbohydrate",
        p_adj_method = "holm",
        zero_cut = 0.90,
        lib_cut = 0,
        group = "group",
        struc_zero = TRUE,
        neg_lb = TRUE,
        alpha = 0.05,
        global = TRUE
      )
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("ANCOM-BC v1 also failed with error:", e$message, "\n")
      NULL
    })

    if (!is.null(out_ancom)) {
      # Tidy results from v1 object
      res_list <- lapply(names(out_ancom$beta), function(term) {
        tibble(
          taxon = rownames(out_ancom$beta[[term]]),
          term = term,
          beta = out_ancom$beta[[term]][, 1],
          se = out_ancom$se[[term]][, 1],
          W = out_ancom$W[[term]][, 1],
          p = out_ancom$p_val[[term]][, 1],
          q = out_ancom$q_val[[term]][, 1],
          diff_abn = out_ancom$diff_abn[[term]][, 1]
        )
      })
      res_tbl <- bind_rows(res_list)
    } else {
      cat("Both ANCOM-BC methods failed. Creating empty result table.\n")
      res_tbl <- NULL
    }
  }

  # Ensure res_tbl exists and has the expected structure
  if (!exists("res_tbl") || is.null(res_tbl)) {
    cat("Warning: res_tbl not created properly. Creating empty result table.\n")
    res_tbl <- tibble(
      taxon = character(0),
      term = character(0),
      beta = numeric(0),
      se = numeric(0),
      W = numeric(0),
      p = numeric(0),
      q = numeric(0),
      diff_abn = logical(0)
    )
  }

  write_csv(res_tbl, "outputs/ancombc_genus_results.csv")
  head(res_tbl)
}
```

### ANCOM-BC Analysis: 48H Timepoint with RDC as Reference

```{r da-ancombc-48h-rdc-reference, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# if the output file already exists, skip the analysis and load the results
if(file.exists("outputs/ancombc_48h_rdc_ref_results.csv")) {
  res_48h_rdc <- read_csv("outputs/ancombc_48h_rdc_ref_results.csv")
  cat("Loaded 48H RDC reference ANCOMBC results from file.\n")
} else { 
# Filter data to 48H timepoint only
ps_48h_raw <- subset_samples(ps_raw, timepoint == "48H")
ps_48h_genus <- subset_samples(ps_genus_filt, timepoint == "48H")

# Remove taxa that are completely absent in 48H samples
ps_48h_raw <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_48h_raw) > 0, ps_48h_raw)
ps_48h_genus <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_48h_genus) > 0, ps_48h_genus)

cat("48H samples for analysis:", nsamples(ps_48h_genus), "\n")
cat("Taxa after 48H filtering:", ntaxa(ps_48h_genus), "\n")

# Relevel carbohydrate factor to use RDC as reference
sample_data_48h <- as.data.frame(sample_data(ps_48h_genus))
sample_data_48h$carbohydrate <- factor(sample_data_48h$carbohydrate, levels = c("RDC", "No Added Carb", "SDC"))

# Update the phyloseq object with releveled factor
sample_data(ps_48h_genus) <- sample_data_48h
sample_data(ps_48h_raw) <- sample_data_48h

# Check the levels
cat("Carbohydrate levels (RDC is reference):", levels(sample_data_48h$carbohydrate), "\n")
cat("Sample distribution by carbohydrate:\n")
print(table(sample_data_48h$carbohydrate))

# Run ANCOM-BC analysis if results don't exist
if(file.exists("outputs/ancombc_48h_rdc_ref_results.csv")) {
  res_48h_rdc <- read_csv("outputs/ancombc_48h_rdc_ref_results.csv")
  cat("Loaded 48H RDC reference ANCOMBC results from file.\n")
} else {
  use_ancombc2_48h <- "ancombc2" %in% getNamespaceExports("ANCOMBC")
  
  if (use_ancombc2_48h) {
    cat("Running ANCOMBC2 for 48H timepoint with RDC as reference...\n")
    
    # Set RDC as the reference level for carbohydrate
    sample_data(ps_48h_raw)$carbohydrate <- relevel(sample_data(ps_48h_raw)$carbohydrate, ref = "RDC")
    cat("Carbohydrate levels (RDC is reference):", levels(sample_data(ps_48h_raw)$carbohydrate), "\n")
    
    out_ancom_48h <- tryCatch({
      ANCOMBC::ancombc2(
        data = ps_48h_raw,
        tax_level = "Genus",
        fix_formula = "group + carbohydrate",  # Only group and carbohydrate since we're at single timepoint
        rand_formula = "(1|SubjectID)",
        p_adj_method = "holm",
        prv_cut = 0.10,
        lib_cut = 0,
        s0_perc = 0.05,
        group = "carbohydrate",  # Primary interest is carbohydrate effects
        struc_zero = TRUE,
        neg_lb = TRUE,
        alpha = 0.05,
        n_cl = 1,
        global = TRUE
      )
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("ANCOMBC2 failed with error:", e$message, "\n")
      cat("Falling back to ANCOM-BC v1...\n")
      NULL
    })
    
    if (!is.null(out_ancom_48h)) {
      # Extract results from ANCOMBC2
      res_48h_rdc <- out_ancom_48h$res
    } else {
      use_ancombc2_48h <- FALSE  # Force fallback
    }
  }
  
  if (!use_ancombc2_48h) {
    cat("Using ANCOM-BC (v1) for 48H analysis...\n")
    
    # Set RDC as the reference level for carbohydrate
    sample_data(ps_48h_genus)$carbohydrate <- relevel(sample_data(ps_48h_genus)$carbohydrate, ref = "RDC")
    cat("Carbohydrate levels (RDC is reference):", levels(sample_data(ps_48h_genus)$carbohydrate), "\n")
    
    out_ancom_48h <- tryCatch({
      ANCOMBC::ancombc(
        phyloseq = ps_48h_genus,
        formula = "group + carbohydrate",
        p_adj_method = "holm",
        zero_cut = 0.90,
        lib_cut = 0,
        group = "carbohydrate",
        struc_zero = TRUE,
        neg_lb = TRUE,
        alpha = 0.05,
        global = TRUE
      )
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("ANCOM-BC v1 also failed with error:", e$message, "\n")
      NULL
    })
    
    if (!is.null(out_ancom_48h)) {
      # Use the res data frame directly - it already has the structure we need
      res_48h_rdc <- out_ancom_48h$res
    } else {
      cat("Both ANCOM-BC methods failed for 48H analysis. Creating empty result table.\n")
      res_48h_rdc <- tibble(
        taxon = character(0),
        term = character(0),
        beta = numeric(0),
        se = numeric(0),
        W = numeric(0),
        p = numeric(0),
        q = numeric(0),
        diff_abn = logical(0)
      )
    }
  }
  
  write_csv(res_48h_rdc, "outputs/ancombc_48h_rdc_ref_results.csv")
}


cat("ANCOM-BC 48H Results Summary:\n")
if (nrow(res_48h_rdc) > 0) {
  cat("Total taxa tested:", length(unique(res_48h_rdc$taxon)), "\n")
  
  # Summary by term
  # Create summary by term for wide format data
  summary_by_term <- tibble(
    term = c("carbohydrateNo.Added.Carb", "carbohydrateSDC", "groupObese"),
    term_clean = c("No Added Carb vs RDC", "SDC vs RDC", "Health Group Effect"),
    total_taxa = nrow(res_48h_rdc),
    significant = c(
      sum(res_48h_rdc$q_carbohydrateNo.Added.Carb < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
      sum(res_48h_rdc$q_carbohydrateSDC < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
      sum(res_48h_rdc$q_groupObese < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  ) %>%
    mutate(prop_significant = round(significant / total_taxa * 100, 1))
  
  print(summary_by_term)
} else {
  cat("No results to summarize.\n")
}

head(res_48h_rdc)
}
```

```{r ancombc-48h-summary-table, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Create comprehensive summary table for 48H RDC reference analysis
if (nrow(res_48h_rdc) > 0) {
  
  # Extract carbohydrate effect results (No Added Carb and SDC vs RDC reference)
  carb_effects <- res_48h_rdc %>%
    # Filter for significant carbohydrate effects
    filter(q_carbohydrateNo.Added.Carb < 0.05 | q_carbohydrateSDC < 0.05) %>%
    # Create separate rows for each comparison
    bind_rows(
      # No Added Carb vs RDC
      filter(res_48h_rdc, q_carbohydrateNo.Added.Carb < 0.05) %>%
        select(taxon, lfc_carbohydrateNo.Added.Carb, se_carbohydrateNo.Added.Carb, p_carbohydrateNo.Added.Carb, q_carbohydrateNo.Added.Carb, diff_carbohydrateNo.Added.Carb) %>%
        rename(beta = lfc_carbohydrateNo.Added.Carb, se = se_carbohydrateNo.Added.Carb, p = p_carbohydrateNo.Added.Carb, q = q_carbohydrateNo.Added.Carb, diff_abn = diff_carbohydrateNo.Added.Carb) %>%
        mutate(term = "carbohydrateNo.Added.Carb", term_clean = "No Added Carb vs RDC"),
      # SDC vs RDC  
      filter(res_48h_rdc, q_carbohydrateSDC < 0.05) %>%
        select(taxon, lfc_carbohydrateSDC, se_carbohydrateSDC, p_carbohydrateSDC, q_carbohydrateSDC, diff_carbohydrateSDC) %>%
        rename(beta = lfc_carbohydrateSDC, se = se_carbohydrateSDC, p = p_carbohydrateSDC, q = q_carbohydrateSDC, diff_abn = diff_carbohydrateSDC) %>%
        mutate(term = "carbohydrateSDC", term_clean = "SDC vs RDC")
    ) %>%
    arrange(term, desc(abs(beta))) %>%
    mutate(
      direction = ifelse(beta > 0, "Higher vs RDC", "Lower vs RDC"),
      fold_change = exp(beta)
    )
  
  # Create summary table
  if (nrow(carb_effects) > 0) {
    cat("\n=== SIGNIFICANT CARBOHYDRATE EFFECTS AT 48H (vs RDC Reference) ===\n")
    
    summary_table <- carb_effects %>%
      select(Genus, term_clean, beta, fold_change, direction, p, q, 
             Phylum, Family) %>%
      arrange(term_clean, desc(abs(beta)))
    
    print(summary_table)
    
    # Save detailed results
    write_csv(carb_effects, "outputs/ancombc_48h_carb_effects_vs_rdc.csv")
    write_csv(summary_table, "outputs/ancombc_48h_summary_table.csv")
    
    # Count by comparison and direction
    effect_counts <- carb_effects %>%
      group_by(term_clean, direction) %>%
      summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
      arrange(term_clean, direction)
    
    cat("\n=== EFFECT COUNTS BY COMPARISON ===\n")
    print(effect_counts)
    
    # Top genera by effect size for each comparison
    top_effects <- carb_effects %>%
      group_by(term_clean) %>%
      slice_max(order_by = abs(beta), n = 5) %>%
      select(term_clean, Genus, beta, fold_change, q) %>%
      arrange(term_clean, desc(abs(beta)))
    
    cat("\n=== TOP 5 GENERA BY EFFECT SIZE FOR EACH COMPARISON ===\n")
    print(top_effects)
    
  } else {
    cat("No significant carbohydrate effects found in 48H analysis.\n")
  }
  
} else {
  cat("No results available for summary table.\n")
}
```

```{r ancombc-48h-forest-plots, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=10}
# Forest plots for 48H carbohydrate effects vs RDC reference

if (nrow(res_48h_rdc) > 0) {
  
  # Function to create forest plot for 48H analysis
  plot_48h_forest <- function(data, term_pattern, title_suffix, top_n = 20) {
    
    df <- data %>%
      filter(grepl(term_pattern, term, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
      mutate(
        ci_l = beta - 1.96 * se,
        ci_u = beta + 1.96 * se,
        sig = q < 0.05,
        direction = ifelse(beta > 0, "Higher vs RDC", "Lower vs RDC"),
        genus_label = ifelse(!is.na(Genus) & Genus != "", Genus, taxon)
      )
    
    if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)
    
    # Take top N by absolute effect size, prioritizing significant results
    df_plot <- df %>%
      arrange(desc(sig), desc(abs(beta))) %>%
      slice_head(n = top_n) %>%
      mutate(genus_label = factor(genus_label, levels = rev(unique(genus_label[order(beta)]))))
    
    p <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = beta, y = genus_label, color = direction)) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "grey50") +
      geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = ci_l, xmax = ci_u, alpha = sig), height = 0.3) +
      geom_point(aes(size = sig, alpha = sig)) +
      scale_alpha_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 1.0, "FALSE" = 0.4), guide = "none") +
      scale_size_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 2.5, "FALSE" = 1.5), guide = "none") +
      ggsci::scale_color_lancet() +
      labs(
        x = "Log fold-change (bias-corrected)",
        y = NULL,
        title = paste("48H Carbohydrate Effects:", title_suffix),
        subtitle = "Solid/large points: FDR < 0.05; Faded/small points: FDR ≥ 0.05",
        color = "Direction"
      ) +
      theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
      theme(
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10)
      )
    
    return(p)
  }
  
  # Create plots for each comparison
  plots_48h <- list()
  
  # Create long format data for forest plots
  forest_data_48h <- bind_rows(
    # No Added Carb vs RDC
    res_48h_rdc %>%
      select(taxon, lfc_carbohydrateNo.Added.Carb, se_carbohydrateNo.Added.Carb, p_carbohydrateNo.Added.Carb, q_carbohydrateNo.Added.Carb, diff_carbohydrateNo.Added.Carb) %>%
      rename(beta = lfc_carbohydrateNo.Added.Carb, se = se_carbohydrateNo.Added.Carb, p = p_carbohydrateNo.Added.Carb, q = q_carbohydrateNo.Added.Carb, diff_abn = diff_carbohydrateNo.Added.Carb) %>%
      mutate(term = "carbohydrateNo.Added.Carb"),
    # SDC vs RDC
    res_48h_rdc %>%
      select(taxon, lfc_carbohydrateSDC, se_carbohydrateSDC, p_carbohydrateSDC, q_carbohydrateSDC, diff_carbohydrateSDC) %>%
      rename(beta = lfc_carbohydrateSDC, se = se_carbohydrateSDC, p = p_carbohydrateSDC, q = q_carbohydrateSDC, diff_abn = diff_carbohydrateSDC) %>%
      mutate(term = "carbohydrateSDC"),
    # Group effect
    res_48h_rdc %>%
      select(taxon, lfc_groupObese, se_groupObese, p_groupObese, q_groupObese, diff_groupObese) %>%
      rename(beta = lfc_groupObese, se = se_groupObese, p = p_groupObese, q = q_groupObese, diff_abn = diff_groupObese) %>%
      mutate(term = "groupObese")
  )
  
  # No Added Carb vs RDC
  if (any(grepl("carbohydrateNo.Added.Carb", forest_data_48h$term, ignore.case = TRUE))) {
    plots_48h$no_carb <- plot_48h_forest(forest_data_48h, "carbohydrateNo.Added.Carb", "No Added Carb vs RDC")
  }
  
  # SDC vs RDC  
  if (any(grepl("carbohydrateSDC", forest_data_48h$term, ignore.case = TRUE))) {
    plots_48h$sdc <- plot_48h_forest(forest_data_48h, "carbohydrateSDC", "SDC vs RDC")
  }
  
  # Group effect for reference
  if (any(grepl("groupObese", forest_data_48h$term, ignore.case = TRUE))) {
    plots_48h$group <- plot_48h_forest(forest_data_48h, "groupObese", "Health Group Effect")
  }
  
  # Combine and display plots
  valid_plots <- plots_48h[!sapply(plots_48h, is.null)]
  
  if (length(valid_plots) > 0) {
    # Save individual plots
    for (nm in names(valid_plots)) {
      ggsave(file.path("outputs", paste0("ancombc_48h_forest_", nm, "_vs_rdc.png")), 
             valid_plots[[nm]], width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)
    }
    
    # Display combined plot
    if (length(valid_plots) == 1) {
      print(valid_plots[[1]])
    } else {
      combined_48h <- cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = valid_plots, ncol = 1, align = "v")
      print(combined_48h)
      
      # Save combined plot
      ggsave("outputs/ancombc_48h_forest_combined_vs_rdc.png", combined_48h, 
             width = 12, height = 6 * length(valid_plots), dpi = 300)
    }
  } else {
    cat("No valid forest plots could be created for 48H analysis.\n")
  }
  
} else {
  cat("No data available for 48H forest plots.\n")
}
```

### Notes on Modeling Choices

- Corncob: SubjectID is included as a blocking (fixed) factor since random effects are not supported in differentialTest. This adjusts for repeated measures when testing each effect by drop-one comparison.
- ANCOM-BC2: Uses `rand_formula = (1|SubjectID)` to include a subject-specific random intercept when available; falls back to ANCOM-BC v1 otherwise.
- LEfSe: Uses `subclass = SubjectID` to perform paired LEfSe appropriate for repeated measures.

```{r ancombc-forest-plots, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=14, fig.height=24}
# Forest plots for ANCOM-BC results (effect sizes with 95% CI)

make_pretty_term <- function(term_key) {
  # Map internal column suffixes to readable labels
  term_key <- as.character(term_key)
  term_key <- gsub("[()]+", "", term_key)
  case_when(
    term_key == "groupObese" ~ "Group: Obese vs Healthy",
    term_key == "timepoint48H" ~ "Timepoint: 48H vs reference",
    term_key == "carbohydrateRDC" ~ "Carbohydrate: RDC vs No Added Carb",
    term_key == "carbohydrateSDC" ~ "Carbohydrate: SDC vs No Added Carb",
    TRUE ~ term_key
  )
}

plot_forest_from_wide <- function(res_wide, term_key, top_n = 25, alpha = 0.05,
                                  title_prefix = "ANCOM-BC Genus Effects") {
  lfc_col <- paste0("lfc_", term_key)
  se_col  <- paste0("se_", term_key)
  q_col   <- paste0("q_", term_key)
  diff_col<- paste0("diff_", term_key)

  if (!all(c("taxon", lfc_col) %in% names(res_wide))) return(NULL)

  df <- res_wide %>%
    transmute(
      taxon,
      term = make_pretty_term(term_key),
      lfc = as.numeric(.data[[lfc_col]]),
      se  = ifelse(se_col %in% names(res_wide), as.numeric(.data[[se_col]]), NA_real_),
      q   = ifelse(q_col %in% names(res_wide), as.numeric(.data[[q_col]]), NA_real_),
      diff= ifelse(diff_col %in% names(res_wide), .data[[diff_col]], NA)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      # Ensure se is numeric and handle any remaining non-numeric values
      se = ifelse(is.na(se) | !is.finite(se), NA_real_, as.numeric(se)),
      ci_l = ifelse(is.na(se), NA_real_, lfc - 1.96 * se), 
      ci_u = ifelse(is.na(se), NA_real_, lfc + 1.96 * se),
      sig = ifelse(!is.na(q) & q < alpha, TRUE, FALSE),
      direction = ifelse(lfc > 0, "Higher", "Lower")
    )

  # Keep significant taxa, or top by |lfc|
  df_sig <- df %>% filter(sig)
  if (nrow(df_sig) == 0) {
    df_sig <- df %>% slice_max(order_by = abs(lfc), n = min(top_n, nrow(df)))
  } else {
    df_sig <- df_sig %>% arrange(desc(abs(lfc))) %>% slice_head(n = min(top_n, nrow(df_sig)))
  }

  df_sig <- df_sig %>% mutate(taxon = factor(taxon, levels = rev(unique(taxon[order(lfc)]))))

  ggplot(df_sig, aes(x = lfc, y = taxon, color = direction)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "grey50") +
    geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = ci_l, xmax = ci_u), height = 0.2, alpha = 0.9) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    ggsci::scale_color_lancet() +
    labs(x = "Log fold-change (bias-corrected)", y = NULL,
         title = paste(title_prefix, "-", make_pretty_term(term_key))) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(axis.text = element_text(color = "black"))
}

plot_forest_from_long <- function(res_long, term_key, top_n = 25, alpha = 0.05,
                                  title_prefix = "ANCOM-BC Genus Effects") {
  df <- res_long %>% filter(term == term_key) %>%
    transmute(
      taxon, 
      term = make_pretty_term(term_key), 
      lfc = as.numeric(beta), 
      se = as.numeric(se), 
      q = as.numeric(q), 
      diff = diff_abn
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      # Ensure se is numeric and handle any remaining non-numeric values
      se = ifelse(is.na(se) | !is.finite(se), NA_real_, as.numeric(se)),
      ci_l = ifelse(is.na(se), NA_real_, lfc - 1.96 * se), 
      ci_u = ifelse(is.na(se), NA_real_, lfc + 1.96 * se),
      sig = ifelse(!is.na(q) & q < alpha, TRUE, FALSE),
      direction = ifelse(lfc > 0, "Higher", "Lower")
    )

  df_sig <- df %>% filter(sig)
  if (nrow(df_sig) == 0) {
    df_sig <- df %>% slice_max(order_by = abs(lfc), n = min(top_n, nrow(df)))
  } else {
    df_sig <- df_sig %>% arrange(desc(abs(lfc))) %>% slice_head(n = min(top_n, nrow(df_sig)))
  }
  df_sig <- df_sig %>% mutate(taxon = factor(taxon, levels = rev(unique(taxon[order(lfc)]))))

  ggplot(df_sig, aes(x = lfc, y = taxon, color = direction)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "grey50") +
    geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = ci_l, xmax = ci_u), height = 0.2, alpha = 0.9) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    ggsci::scale_color_lancet() +
    labs(x = "Log fold-change (bias-corrected)", y = NULL,
         title = paste(title_prefix, "-", make_pretty_term(term_key))) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(axis.text = element_text(color = "black"))
}

# Decide which plotting path to use based on res_tbl structure
is_wide <- any(grepl("^lfc_", names(res_tbl)))

terms_to_plot <- c("groupObese", "timepoint48H", "carbohydrateRDC", "carbohydrateSDC")
plots <- list()
for (tm in terms_to_plot) {
  p <- if (is_wide) plot_forest_from_wide(res_tbl, tm) else plot_forest_from_long(res_tbl, tm)
  if (!is.null(p)) plots[[tm]] <- p
}

# Save individual plots and show a combined grid of available ones
plot_list <- plots[!vapply(plots, is.null, logical(1))]
if (length(plot_list) > 0) {
  for (nm in names(plot_list)) {
    ggsave(file.path("outputs", paste0("ancombc_forest_", nm, ".png")), plot_list[[nm]],
           width = 8.5, height = 6.5, dpi = 300)
  }
  cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = plot_list, ncol = 1)
}
```

```{r maaslin2-da-analysis}
library(Maaslin2)

count_df <- data.frame(otu_table(ps_genus_filt))

maaslin2_output <-invisible(Maaslin2(input_data=count_df, input_metadata=metadata,
                                     output = file.path("outputs", 'maaslin2_output'),
```
